name: gemm_nn
summary: C = A B with A M x K, B K x N, C M x N, all f32 row-major
provenance: authored for OpenAccel Lab (Apache-2.0); BLAS SGEMM NN semantics with alpha=1, beta=0

C.why: each C[i][j] is a length-K dot product; in any summation order, fused or not, |err| <= gamma(K)*sum_k |A[i][k] B[k][j]| (Higham Thm 3.1/3.5); reference.py passes that sum as scale. WolframLanguageEvaluator: g[n_]:=n 2^-24/(1-n 2^-24); N[g[72],6] -> 4.29155*10^-6, N[g[19],6] -> 1.13249*10^-6
